## About
Naylor Automotive Engineering Co., Inc. remanufactures clutches, transmissions, differentials and brakes for medium and heavy duty trucks. We also provide brake friction services for off-highway equipment and the industrial manufacturing community.
Richard 'Dick' Naylor and his son, Glenn, started the business selling automotive cores, then moved into clutch remanufacturing at the urging of their customers. Today Paul Januska leads the company as President, and we work out of our facility on South Knox Avenue as one of the last remaining clutch remanufacturers in the Northern Illinois area.
Remanufacturing existing components gives you a more economical alternative to buying new parts and keeps raw material in use. We serve commercial transportation, utilities, construction, off-highway, airports, automotive service dealers, and resale and retail dealers. Customers rate us 4.8 from 42 Google reviews.

## Services
- Truck Transmission Rebuilding: Rebuilding of transmissions for medium and heavy duty trucks.
- Truck Clutches: New and remanufactured clutches for medium and heavy duty trucks.
- Truck Clutch Rebuilding: Clutch remanufacturing, the work this company was built on, including relining clutch discs.
- Truck Friction Bands & Brake Shoes: Friction bands and brake shoes, including relining of brake shoes.
- Differentials: Remanufactured differentials for medium and heavy duty trucks.
- Brake friction services for off-highway equipment: Brake friction work for off-highway equipment and industrial manufacturing customers.
- Friction material bonding: Friction material bonding service for industrial applications.

## FAQ
Q: What kind of vehicles do you work on?
A: Medium to heavy duty trucks. We also handle brake friction work for off-highway equipment and industrial customers.

Q: Do you pick up and deliver?
A: Yes. Our rapid turnaround service includes free pickup and delivery.

Q: Who do you sell to?
A: Commercial transportation, utilities, construction, off-highway, airports and automotive service dealers, as well as resale and retail dealers.

Q: Are you open on Saturday?
A: Yes, Saturday from 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM.

Q: Do you have resale and exemption forms?
A: Yes. We keep the Rolling Stock Certificate, Equipment Exemption Certificate, Certificate of Resale and a credit application on hand.
